author: Krishna Kallamadi
status_note: The 17 accepted implementation stages below preserve their historical evidence. Later testing verified eight enabled integrations on the private hosted Site: Fireworks, Nebius, Pinecone, Tavily, Keenable, Mem0, LangSmith and LlamaParse. OpenAI passed local direct inference but is disabled on the Site; ElevenLabs remains parked. See the current service matrix and hosted validation report. Browser/load testing and submission receipt are not established by these API checks.

stages.title: Scope and architecture
stages.goal: Define a bounded recovery product and a shared web and native architecture before implementation.
deliverables: Product boundary and phased implementation plan
TypeScript workspace and common domain contract
Human approval and synthetic-data design decisions

checks.text: Architecture and platform choices documented
Implemented versus future capability boundary explicit
Existing platform capabilities acknowledged

stages.evidence: Implementation plan, API contract and primary-source manifest are present and reviewed.

stages.title: Repository and foundation
stages.goal: Create the private version-controlled project and establish reproducible development entry points.
deliverables: Private krish339-ai/RescueRelay repository
npm workspace manifests and shared types
Ignored secrets, runtime data and QA intermediates

checks.text: Private repository created in the requested account
Initial foundation commit pushed and remote verified

stages.evidence: Private remote confirmed at initial foundation commit 231ae385bd26d299d15aedd18d06f37762ce9e31. Later commits extend that foundation.

stages.title: Accounts and persistence
stages.goal: Enforce identity, organization isolation, roles and durable state at the API boundary.
deliverables: Scrypt password hashes and expiring opaque sessions
SQLite transactions and versioned organization state
Role-filtered snapshots and coordinator-managed accounts

checks.text: Unauthorized and cross-organization requests are rejected
Logout and role restrictions are exercised
State and sessions behave correctly after database reopen

stages.evidence: Accepted backend milestone: API suite 20/20 and independent QA 20/20 passed, including authentication, role/organization boundaries, logout and persistent database reopen. These 40 checks are shared evidence across backend stages, not 40 separate checks per stage.

stages.title: Rescue operations
stages.goal: Support the donation-to-receipt workflow without weakening operational constraints.
deliverables: Partner, volunteer, donation and rescue records
Acceptance, pickup, delivery and receiving acknowledgment
Cancellation, custody-aware escalation and resolution

checks.text: Forward transitions and acceptance requirements tested
Unsupported handling and invalid windows rejected
Active commitments and food custody remain protected

stages.evidence: API-level operations accepted: acceptance and forward transitions, unsupported handling, active-commitment guards, custody-aware interruption and coordinator resolution passed the shared backend regression set. Browser and native interaction review remains in separate stages.

stages.title: Policy retrieval and recovery reasoning
stages.goal: Make recovery recommendations inspectable and keep deterministic checks authoritative.
deliverables: Local lexical policy retrieval with source excerpts
Offline bounded planner and candidate rejection details
Optional allowlisted read-only provider investigation

checks.text: Policy citations reproduce persisted evidence
Feasible and infeasible synthetic cases behave as expected
Provider scope, schemas and tool budgets are enforced

stages.evidence: Offline recovery evaluation passed 12/12 synthetic scenarios. Local policy evidence, maximum feasible matching and provider guardrails passed offline and mocked-provider tests. No live paid provider call was performed or validated.

stages.title: Recovery proposals and approval
stages.goal: Ensure that only a reviewed, current, feasible proposal can alter a rescue.
deliverables: Version-bound proposals with ten-minute expiry
Transactional revalidation and idempotent approval
Audit events and in-app notification records

checks.text: Stale or expired proposals cannot be applied
Duplicate retries cannot apply recovery twice
Infeasible and custody-held work cannot auto-reassign

stages.evidence: Accepted approval evidence: version/expiry guards, idempotent replay, deterministic revalidation, infeasibility and custody protections passed the shared backend regression checks. UI approval interaction review is still tracked separately.

stages.title: Responsive web and installable shell
stages.goal: Provide a usable coordinator workspace and role-specific browser experiences.
deliverables: Landing page and responsive operational workspace
Partner forms, recovery evidence and approval controls
Web manifest and non-sensitive application shell cache

checks.text: Desktop and narrow-layout user journeys reviewed
Forms, errors, empty states and role views exercised
Authenticated API data excluded from shell caching

stages.evidence: Accepted browser review at 17:30 UTC: actual delivered web server and API, desktop 1182 CSS pixels and narrow 500 pixels. Recovery review/approval, role-scoped lifecycle/receipt, CSV validation/import/export, no-capacity escalation, navigation focus repair, real API outage feedback and restart recovery passed. Exact 390-pixel application layout, physical touch, offline service-worker behavior and installation remain unverified.

stages.title: Android and iOS client source

Native session storage with explicit fallback

checks.text: Native source typechecks and target bundles export
Mobile transport and domain helpers pass tests

A 430px React Native Web canvas passed sign-in, role switching, recovery evidence/approval, acceptance/cancellation and error feedback. Physical devices, native SecureStore runtime, compilation and signing remain unverified.

stages.title: Data utilities and local operations
stages.goal: Support reproducible input, inspection and local operation without external side effects.

checks.text: Malformed or unsupported imports fail without partial writes

stages.evidence: CSV validation/import/export checks passed. Local database integrity, consistent backup, new-file restore with session invalidation, restart persistence and built-web static-server checks were exercised. Managed deployment and enterprise operations remain out of scope. Final browser review also passed valid and invalid CSV import paths and export download against the actual API.

current_release.title: Rescue Pipeline and Liquid Organic workspace
current_release.scope: Full-width grouped navigation; snapshot-derived rescue lanes and explicit terminal views; readable 16px body text; organic Framer Motion entry with reduced-motion controls. Existing roles, routes and server-authorized actions are preserved. Separate Expo native screens are unchanged.
current_release.evidence: Initial local verification passed 130 tests, 9 native/API checkpoints, 12 offline evaluations with zero provider calls, typechecks and web build. The aggregate failed at Expo export with SIGKILL; an explicit all-platform --max-workers 1 retry exited 0. After a terminal-label fix, web tests passed 25/25 and web build passed again: 131 constituent tests including earlier API 33, native 19 and independent QA 54, not a fresh full aggregate run. Actual-app desktop and approximately 500px narrow review passed; role scopes, volunteer Accept dialog, receipt distinction, rapid navigation/refresh and local reduced-motion preference persistence were checked. The updated 20-page DOCX was rendered and every page inspected at 21:02 UTC; author and canonical service-matrix checks passed. Fresh implementation CI run 41128268002 passed for commit 9057ea4c46e446135d8d62636597b8572419c28f: verification job 124312296895 and Windows launcher job 124312296454 both succeeded. Logs confirm 131 tests, 12 evaluations with zero provider calls and all platform exports. This fresh aggregate CI pass is distinct from the earlier local retry. Windows pulled clean HEAD 9057ea4, installed dependencies and passed full verification with 130 tests passed, zero failed and one existing POSIX-only test skipped; 9 integration checkpoints, 12 evaluations, all platform exports and 24 launcher assertions passed. Direct/proxied health and the pipeline component/CSS returned HTTP 200. Local Windows browser visuals were not exercised; the cloud browser review is separate. Final updated DOCX review passed at 21:13 UTC: 20 pages, with changed pages visually re-inspected and all other page PNGs byte-identical to the complete earlier page review.
current_release.boundary: No live provider, external dispatch, physical-device certification or production readiness is claimed. OS reduced-motion emulation and exact animation-frame timing were not exercised.
